correctness.rationale: Definitions cover uniform without-replacement k-leaf samples, ultrametric root height and strict maxima. V1=0 for any ultrametric tree proves impossibility below five leaves. A complete exact enumeration of all 5-leaf subsets gives three symbolic covariance polynomials and the exact strict necessary/sufficient quadratic inequalities. Positive rational depths (14/15,1/3,2/5) give V2=32/375, V3=317/4500, V4=28/375. Pure Python standard-library checker verifies every symbolic coefficient and the rational gaps 67/4500,19/4500, plus 44 other parameter triples. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for the claimed fixed five-tip topology and is not misused as a bound on larger n.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The 2013 moment formula is broader in computable trees and samples, and every specific five-tip variance polynomial is a direct algebraic specialization of it. The exact phase region and first-onset threshold are the asserted addition. This relation to a master formula is a material originality risk, explicitly acknowledged.

value.rationale: The conditional variance curve of rooted phylogenetic diversity is a natural measure of sampling-depth uncertainty in species-based rarefaction. A doubly peaked profile on a genuine positive-length time-calibrated tree shows precision can worsen after it first improves. The sharp global five-leaf onset is meaningful and the nonempty strict quadratic phase region classifies stability under all admissible three-height perturbations of the displayed topology; no claim of broad typicality or a new mean/variance formula is made.
